limitations: Score is a share of the published, eligible lists. It is not a card win rate, forecast or complete population metagame share.
Historical Pro Tours remain outside the recent score. A pre-release event does not create an observed absence.
Published tournament placements are counted only when available. Missing ranks remain null in source examples.
Watch/repeated-use labels describe observations and do not predict future competitive or price success.
